places.name: Miles City
places.note: Call sleeps in the livery, has a coffin built, packs Augustus in charcoal and salt in the doctor's harness shed to await spring, and buys winter supplies.
places.location_hint: on the Yellowstone River; a town where half the citizens seem drunk

places.name: Salt lick north of Miles City
places.note: Call drives a borrowed wagon there and shovels salt for packing the coffin; antelope, buffalo and elk sign around it.
places.location_hint: about six miles north of Miles City, reached by following game trails

places.name: Montana
places.note: Call rejoins the grazing herd and reports Augustus's death; watching Indians with families, likely Crow, haven't attacked.
places.location_hint: open plains north of the Yellowstone, about a day and a half's slow ride from Miles City, near or beyond the Musselshell

places.name: Musselshell River
places.note: Old Hugh plans to bring the supply wagon on and meet Call north of it.

places.name: Texas
places.note: The town gossips about the dead man to be hauled there; the hands debate whether Call will really carry him back.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Where Jake died; Dish recalls Lorena sitting before her tent on its plains.

places.name: Wyoming
places.note: Where Deets died, as Call counts his lost comrades.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Dish thinks of Lorena waiting there for Augustus and hopes to go win her himself.

places.name: Georgia
places.note: The old liveryman would prefer to be buried there but knows no one will carry him.

places.name: Missouri
places.note: Gill buried his wife there, where it is warmer.

places.name: Virginia
places.note: Lippy recalls a quick one-legged man from there who got around on crutches.

places.name: Tennessee
places.note: Soupy is puzzled by the Texas burial since he'd heard Augustus came from there.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: camped with the herd on the plains north of the Yellowstone, roughly a day and a half's ride from Miles City; Call off alone for the evening

groups.label: Hugh Auld with supply wagon
groups.hint: setting out slowly from Miles City with a supply wagon, to meet Call north of the Musselshell
